verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Payroll documents exporting customizable payroll reports. It also offers the QuickBooks Workforce API (GraphQL, OAuth) with payslip and deduction workflows, plus webhooks that fire when a company runs payroll, so an agent could programmatically pull pay-run data. However, nothing in the evidence describes payroll journal-entry data specifically or any reconciliation of those entries into a ledger. missing for 10: documented payroll journal/GL-entry endpoint or export, documented ledger posting or reconciliation workflow, published OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404), independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven extraction.
